mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction (user_id, message_id, amount, type, category_id, transaction_date, description, tags, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{messageId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{categoryId}, #{transactionDate}, #{description}, #{tags}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE transaction SET amount = #{amount}, type = #{type}, category_id = #{categoryId}, transaction_date = #{transactionDate}, description = #{description}, tags = #{tags}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
